located_point.method: Sentinel-2 composite renders at 3 km, 1.2 km and 600 m (RGB, SWIR). Three bright bare patches lie between a road and a canal-side track; the largest (about 130 m by 160 m, centred near 26.17373 N 68.32284 E) is taken as Mound II, with smaller patches to its north-west and south-west matching the arrangement of Mounds III and I on Mackay 1943 Plate I. The Wikidata starting point falls on the largest patch.

imagery_unmeasurable_reason: Features not resolvable at 10 m: the mounds appear as bright bare patches whose edges are field and track boundaries; no wall or street of the excavated houses (rooms of 2-3 m on the plans) is resolvable.

notes: Imagery located but not measurable. All three plates carry a magnetic needle dated 2 November 1935; bearings are corrected with the IGRF-14 declination for 1935.836 at 26.1736 N 68.3231 E (+0.871 degrees east), and raw values are kept in every line. Walls are drawn as solid black bars; candidate bars were found with scripts-S/wallcands.py (morphological opening at 2 degree steps), reviewed on overlays, selected by hand where they matched a single drawn wall, and refined with measure_lines.py (trough fits on Plates II and IV; edge fits on one face on Plate III, whose bars are 8-12 px wide). Within each plate the deviations form a continuum, so systems are the greedy maximum-length 6 degree windows of scripts-S/group.py. Plate II (Mound I) shows two house groups: the house occupying Square 12/K (text p. 59) and the walls south of it at +2 to +8 degrees (main system), and the western houses (rooms 38, 45-47, 59-62, 12, 22, 49, 63-64) at -6 to 0 degrees. In the 12/K house the north-south walls run 3-5 degrees more clockwise than its east-west walls. Plate IV (Mound II, Harappa II level) has walls from -16 to -29 degrees, with a main window at -28.8 to -22.8 (northern and eastern buildings and STREET 447) and a second at -22.4 to -16.4 (the building with rooms 139/136 and the west side of the street labelled STREET). Plate III (Mound II, upper Harappa level) has a main window at -28.8 to -22.8 and a second at -33.6 to -27.6 (the long wall from 257 to 176 and the rooms west of it). Mounds I and II therefore differ by about 30 degrees relative to the same 1935 magnetic north. cd3-c59 was dropped as a duplicate fit of the same wall face as cd3-c22. Walls are short (2-13 m on the plans), and sigma per line ranges from 0.1 to 1.6 degrees.
